measurement_note: Size is n, the string length. Each tier contains n - 1 lowercase a characters followed by one uppercase A, so A is the answer and every position matters. Set construction is linear. A correct implementation that manually searches the whole string for the opposite case of every position completes all tiers and fails through quadratic scaling.
